name: AppLovin MAX / AppLovin SDK

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always: AppLovin's privacy policy lists advertising IDs (GAID / Amazon Advertising ID) and App Set IDs.
Always: the policy lists IP address plus country, time zone and locale settings. No precise location is listed.
Always: ad interactions and session information used for measurement and reporting of ad activity.
Always: the policy lists device properties (battery, storage, memory, boot time) and app 'performance' and session information.

ask: Do you pass a user ID, email or phone number to the AppLovin SDK (e.g. setUserIdentifier / publisher user ID)? AppLovin's policy lists these 'if provided by publisher'; if yes, declare Personal info / User IDs, Email address or Phone number as shared.
Which networks do you mediate through MAX? Each mediated ad network SDK needs its own disclosure.

sources.title: AppLovin MAX Android privacy (consent flags; no Data safety table)

notes: AppLovin does not appear to publish a Google Play Data safety guide for its Android SDK (none found on support.applovin.com / developers.axon.ai; Play SDK Index page could not be read). These entries are inferred from AppLovin's company-wide privacy policy, which also covers non-SDK products, so a reviewer should confirm before shipping. Purchase/transaction data in the policy comes from advertisers, not from the publisher SDK, so it is not listed. Ephemeral, encryption and deletion answers are not stated. Privacy policy confirmed to list advertising IDs (GAID), App Set IDs, IP address and device properties (battery, storage, memory, boot time). Reviewed 2026-11-13 against the cited pages.
